newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Smit majority to be publicly offered.
newsitem.headline: Smit majority to be publicly offered.

text.p: Shipping group Smit Internationale NV said on Thursday the majority stake in it held by its two major shareholders would be publicly offered.
Smit said in April that transport firm Nedlloyd and unlisted investment group Vigilanter were planning to sell their stakes. They have interests of 40 percent each.

In total, about 5.1 million shares in Smit Internationale will be offered. The banks backing the transaction have an option on an additional 768,724 shares. If that option is fully exercised, Nedlloyd will have sold all its Smit shares and Vigilanter will retain a five percent stake.
More details will be published in a prospectus to be published later.
Credit Suisse First Boston will act as bookrunner for the share offering and merchant bank MeesPierson will also be involved in the transaction.
